# Correctness verdict: BLOCK

PR #212 at `68ecd898a068ac4420b0defb2fd7445f7ccffafd`, answering `01a1c301-c125-7670-9515-77012db46671`. Two source-based correctness findings within AC1. Neither counterexample was executed locally.

**F001: a quoted example inside another fenced block can execute.** `trailing_block_body` finds the last matching opener without tracking an enclosing fence (`crates/core/src/turn_end.rs:109-123`). Text consisting of these four lines: `["```text", "```pij", "send pij-recipient hi", "```"]` is one **text-language** Markdown block; the apparent pij opener is literal example text inside it. The parser nevertheless selects and runs that example. The OMP renderer uses the same backward search (`.omp/extensions/pij/core/turn-end.ts:114-140`). Track enclosing fence state when selecting the trailing executable block, mirror that distinction in display, and add this no-action case. A full Markdown parser is not required.

**F002: send preflight misses deterministic argument refusals.** The first pass calls only `parse_send` (`crates/daemon/src/http/turn_end.rs:187-210`), which permits `--force` without a reason. A block containing `send pij-recipient --fyi "one"` followed by `send pij-recipient --force "two"` therefore passes preflight. With an available recipient, the first FYI is held before the second command refuses in `http/cold_wake.rs:217-224`. An invalid argument has already allowed an earlier side effect, contrary to validate-all-then-run. Reuse/extract the handler's side-effect-free argument checks in preflight, including force/reason, with a focused nothing-ran regression.

**Other requested paths:** ordinary last-of-two blocks, trailing prose and indented fences are covered. Execution delegates to the existing send/output/close handlers; deterministic refusals stop later commands and report ran/refused/not_run. The run survives client cancellation. OMP only blocks a failed stop when `stop_hook_active` is false, redraws aborted/tool-call replies raw, and wires managed assistantText through OMP's config CLI and doctor. Only read-only `omp config get`/help was probed; no settings changed.

Exact-head CI `42733044676`, artifact `13726565343`: **2,363 Rust passes**, six separately skipped; all nine parser and six HTTP cases executed. OMP pure/adapter and link-global suites passed (12/6/37 cases). They do not cover the findings above. `pr-freeze` FINAL/CLEAN; HEAD unchanged. No local builds/tests, product edits or lifecycle operations.

The documented full-HTTP-replay duplication limit remains distinct from selective retry using the returned statuses. The OMP idle-display wait is bounded at 50 ms × 40 ticks per block; performance judgment remains independently owned. C33/C34 applied; lane B is not graded here.
